webster.text: Mutable; subject to change of opinion, inclination or purpose; not firm in resolution; unsteady; fickle; used of persons; as inconstant in love or friendship.

example.quote: An individual who is observed to be inconstant to his plans, or perhaps to carry on his affairs without any plan at all, is marked at once, by all prudent people, as a speedy victim to his own unsteadiness and folly.
